description: This module can be used to join nodes to a cluster, check the status of the cluster.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: The command you would like to perform against the cluster. Choices: "ping" "kv_test" "join" "plan" "commit"

parameters.name: config_dir
parameters.description: The path to the riak configuration directory. Default: "/etc/riak"

parameters.name: http_conn
parameters.description: The IP address and port that is listening for Riak HTTP queries. Default: "127.0.0.1:8098"

parameters.name: target_node
parameters.description: The target node for certain operations (join, ping). Default: "riak@127.0.0.1"

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: If false, SSL certificates are not validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: wait_for_handoffs
parameters.description: Number of seconds to wait for handoffs to complete. Default: 0

parameters.name: wait_for_ring
parameters.description: Number of seconds to wait for all nodes to agree on the ring. Default: 0

parameters.name: wait_for_service
parameters.description: Waits for a riak service to come online before continuing. Choices: "kv"

examples:
- name: "Join's a Riak node to another node"
  community.general.riak:
    command: join
    target_node: riak@10.1.1.1

- name: Wait for handoffs to finish. Use with async and poll.
  community.general.riak:
    wait_for_handoffs: true

- name: Wait for riak_kv service to startup
  community.general.riak:
    wait_for_service: kv
